decision_rule.reference: shipped = final_resnet50 + e_cnxt_small + final_swin_t, equal-weight mean_logit, views orig+flip, threshold 0.5
decision_rule.data: val fold 0 of data/splits/split_v1.csv (1408 images), 23 robustness variants
decision_rule.bootstrap: paired, 1000 reps over val images, seed 0
pass_if: 95% CI lower bound > 0 for both gains
T4 time for 3000 images < 150 s (4060 Ti in-script time x 3.5, then confirmed on a Kaggle T4 before shipping)
decision_rule.several_pass: take the one with the largest worst-variant CI lower bound; the union of passers (E10) is scored once and taken only if it also passes and beats that one on both lower bounds
decision_rule.none_pass: shipped bundle, predictions.csv and TF models stay untouched

fusion.add_on: logit = 0.8*mean(shipped 3 member logits) + 0.2*new member logit, flip TTA on every member

rerun_policy: rerun only for a crash, OOM or a run that did not learn (val AUC < 0.75 after 4 epochs); log it as such. No hyperparameter retuning after seeing val. Each candidate set is scored exactly once.
